# Relative position is zero-sum; a race ends those ahead only through their dependence

<!-- Generated by tools/research/registry.py; edit the matching JSON record. -->

`relative-position-is-zero-sum` · **recorded-checked** · theorem · F01 · [record](relative-position-is-zero-sum.json) · [register](../../../../RESULTS.md)

> A part's position against the others is zero-sum by counting: its rise is the rest's summed fall, whatever the amounts do. A race of joint excess ends a part through its dependence on the condition, not its position; where those ahead do not so depend, they can continue.

<a id="laws--规律"></a>
## Laws

1. Zero-sum is counting. A part's position is its amount counted once for each part (ahead) against the family's total (behind); over the family the ahead counts total what the behind counts total. Across every change of amounts the rise counts total what the fall counts total, so a part's change of position is the opposite of the change summed over the rest, and where it rises the rest's summed position falls. (`Becoming.total_const`, `Becoming.RelativePosition.total_split`, `Becoming.RelativePosition.positions_balance`, `Becoming.RelativePosition.riseCount`, `Becoming.RelativePosition.fallCount`, `Becoming.RelativePosition.change_balances`, `Becoming.RelativePosition.change_opposed`, `Becoming.RelativePosition.rest_falls_of_rises`)
2. No change raises every part's position, and a part's rise needs another part's fall, found by a decided comparison, not by contradiction. (`Becoming.RelativePosition.total_lt_of_mem`, `Becoming.RelativePosition.not_all_rise`, `Becoming.RelativePosition.below_somewhere_or_not`, `Becoming.RelativePosition.rise_needs_fall`)
3. A nonempty family has a greatest part, no part's amount exceeding its own, and its position is not below the family's. (`Becoming.RelativePosition.Greatest`, `Becoming.RelativePosition.greatest_exists`, `Becoming.RelativePosition.greatest_not_behind`)
4. On a flow, read by what each part of a family has drawn from a condition, between any two steps, the laws above hold with no hypothesis on the flow; and where every part draws more, a part's position can still fall. (`Becoming.Flow.drawn`, `Becoming.Flow.drawn_positions`, `Becoming.DrawingMore.flow`, `Becoming.DrawingMore.grow_and_fall`)
5. The dependence that ends a part at the end of a race, exactly: with balance at the condition across n steps of joint excess from T, a part that at T + n requires the condition, at a need greater than the level at T less n, and is active there only while supported, is not active there. Its position does not enter, and no renewal need be gated. (`Becoming.Flow.excess_leaves_below`, `Becoming.Flow.ends_at_race_end`)
6. With renewal gated (the hypotheses of Flow.joint_excess_ends), the race changes positions by a zero-sum count while the level falls by at least n, the level stays below m, and every part depending on the condition at a need of at least m is inactive from then on, the greatest parts included; in a family whose parts all so depend, at every later step there is a greatest part and every greatest part is inactive. In Race each part takes within what the step gives and together they take more; the greatest part rises in position across the race and ends with the condition, as does every part. (`Becoming.Flow.race_ends_greatest`, `Becoming.Flow.greatest_end_for_good`, `Becoming.Race.Member`, `Becoming.Race.level`, `Becoming.Race.live`, `Becoming.Race.present`, `Becoming.Race.flow`, `Becoming.Race.web`, `Becoming.Race.balances`, `Becoming.Race.live_of_present`, `Becoming.Race.acting`, `Becoming.Race.dependent`, `Becoming.Race.gated`, `Becoming.Race.drawn_renewer`, `Becoming.Race.drawn_second_le`, `Becoming.Race.first_greatest`, `Becoming.Race.excess`, `Becoming.Race.all`, `Becoming.Race.first_rises`, `Becoming.Race.greatest_ends`)

<a id="conditions--条件"></a>
## Conditions

- No axiom. The counting laws use no premise and hold for every reading of amounts. The end at the race's end needs balance at the condition across the race, joint excess at each step, a start below n plus the part's need, and the part requiring the condition and being active only while supported. The end for good adds Flow.joint_excess_ends' hypotheses: balance, only active formations giving, activity needing support and renewal gated at m. The continuation condition enters only as a hypothesis of Clearing.loss_needs_significance.

<a id="does-not-show--未表明"></a>
## Does not show

- That a race for relative position produces joint excess: that is a premise of the join, not derived from the counting law or from any race dynamic.
- That any actual part depends on what its race draws down: for the present race this is the empirical premise the opening calls the entangled Earth.
- Positions read as ranks or shares, several shared conditions with different needs, or the dynamics by which parts race.
- **Counterexample:** Gated renewal is needed for the end to last: in Restored a renewer that requires nothing gives at the race's end; the race ends the part, greatest at every step, at its end (through Flow.ends_at_race_end), and the renewal restores it from the next step on (Restored.returns). [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/RelativePosition.lean)
- **Counterexample:** Dependence is needed: in the clearer's web, read by what each part has drawn from the habitat, the clearer is the greatest part at every step; the habitat is drawn down jointly beyond what is given to it with renewal there gated, and the dweller, which depends on it, ends, while the clearer, which does not, is active and supported at every step (Clearing.greatest_continues). Its loss is one of significance, and needs one: under the continuation condition it loses the dweller from every standpoint, under no significance nothing (Clearing.loss_needs_significance). [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/RelativePosition.lean)

<a id="correspondence--对应"></a>
### Correspondence

States the counting half of the opening's sentence on the game of winning (OPENING, Ren's voice; provenance, not warrant), which read "a zero-sum game of relative position, which, as I see it, all its winners will lose" and whose note [^aligned] had called the zero-sum "a matter of counting, not yet stated on the formal spine", and proves the second half under a stated dependence (board item Z1; v7 proposal, edits (j), (ee), (oo) and (oo′)). With this landing, by Ren's agreement to the proposal's third pass, the body reads "a zero-sum game of relative position, which all its winners will lose wherever they live on what it draws down" (oo) and "A race of position cannot raise everyone" (oo′), and the notes [^aligned] and [^race] cite this record. "Winner" is read as a greatest part by the reading of positions, the AI's reading; the note's sentence is in study section 200.
